title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
summary: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION is Square Enix's Final Fantasy VII game for Switch 2, with a release date of April 8, 2027 and a price of $69.99. Storage is the headline: the pre-release eShop listing puts it at 130.1 GB, more than half of the console's 256 GB internal storage. That figure may change before launch, but it is a strong hint that you will need a microSD Express card or a serious clean-up of your library. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download and does not save any space. Performance figures for Switch 2 have not been published yet. Spanish is among its eight languages.
